title: Negating the first vector of an orthonormal frame keeps it orthonormal with the same span and negates every covector value
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ and let v = (v_0, …, v_d) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P (Euclid P), indexed by Fin (d + 1). Then there is an orthonormal family w = (w_0, …, w_d) in ℝ^P with span{w_0, …, w_d} = span{v_0, …, v_d} and β(w_0, …, w_d) = −β(v_0, …, v_d) for every (d+1)-covector β on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∃ w : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ w ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range w) = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), β w = -β v
